target.name: Shardline S3 frontend (self-hosted content-addressed storage server)

authorization.production_rules: Local source audit of the S3 frontend only. All live testing runs against an in-process router on a random 127.0.0.1 port (the repo's TestServer pattern). No external targets, no production instances. Read-only for finder lanes; PoC execution only through the sandboxed bounty validation runner.

identifiers: commit 9159eb6 (S3 interop hardening: MD5 ETags, user metadata, ListObjects v1, client-breadth real-client e2e)
evidence: pushed to origin/feat/s3-frontend 2026-08-14; all gates green (cargo make ci exit 0)

impact_rules.source: Self-hosted S3-compatible object-storage server; severity mapping for this engagement

critical: Unauthenticated or cross-tenant read/write/delete of arbitrary objects (data exfiltration or destruction)
Authentication bypass (SigV4 access-key=token or Bearer bridge) allowing access to any bucket/object
Path traversal in bucket or key routing escaping the storage root or scope namespace
high: Cross-tenant object access/overwrite via token scope confusion or bucket-name collisions
Upload/part/session quota bypass allowing unbounded storage consumption
Request smuggling / body-desync via AWS-chunked framing (poisoned request splitting)
Race/TOCTOU on object overwrite or multipart session leading to torn or corrupt data
XML entity expansion / injection in listing or CompleteMultipartUpload parsing
low: Hardening gaps (missing security headers, error-envelope details)
Non-destructive robustness issues with no data impact

exclusions: All non-S3 protocol frontends (Xet, LFS, Bazel, OCI, Hub, metrics)
CLI / operator commands except where they mint the S3 token path
Storage adapter backends (local/S3/Postgres) except the shardline_s3_objects index layer used by the S3 listing

accounts.note: LocalHmacProvider token for {owner}.{name}=ac.assets used by the real-client e2e harness; access-key=token, secret arbitrary

known_findings: adv-1 (2026-08-13) audit findings — all FIXED on this branch, do NOT re-report: atomic-overwrite race (fixed via S3ObjectReadSnapshot + read_object_stream_pinned), CLI admin-token key-file newline-strip bug (401), DeleteObjects hardening, chunk-size 64KB default panic + non-power-of-two validation
S3 interop gaps fixed 2026-08-14 (features, not bugs): ETag semantics (content-hash -> MD5), user metadata persistence, ListObjects v1
